scenes.line: You hold a policy with Guardian Life. Your representative has moved on.
So here is the question nobody answers. What happens if you choose not to have an agent at all?
Your policy does not need an agent to work.
Your premiums are collected. Your cover stays in force. A claim is still paid.
The branch still writes to you. A note on your birthday. A reminder before a premium is due.
Call the support desk and somebody answers. None of that has ever depended on having an agent.
So what do you actually give up?
Nobody checks whether the cover you bought still fits the life you have now.
Nobody tells you about the benefits already sitting inside your policy.
And if a payment quietly stops, nobody notices until a letter arrives.
Your premium is priced on the age you were when you started.
Nobody can sell you that price again. Not us. Not anyone.

scenes.eyebrow: What we would rather you did
scenes.line: So have an agent of your own. Qualified, registered, and answerable for the advice they give.
We will match you to one. One click, and we do the rest.
Ricky Rampersad Branch. Guardian Life of the Caribbean.
